document.title: Tourism in remote natural areas
document.question:
Tourists are increasingly travelling to remote and fragile places, such as high mountains, deserts and polar regions. Some believe this brings money and attention to these areas, while others worry about the damage it causes.

Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
